name: SmartPress PRO
author: z10g8

sections.description:
SmartPress PRO is your ultimate AI companion for WordPress — built for creators, developers, and site owners who want to write faster, design smarter, and automate everything with powerful AI tools that feel native to WordPress.

🚀 Write. Generate. Automate. All from your dashboard.

🧠 Features

1. AI Writing Tools
Generate full articles, enhanced content, headlines, SEO descriptions, and more using premium AI models like GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
– Prompt Templates (custom or community-powered)
– Smart Variables and Output Rules (HTML, plain text, tags, etc.)
– Prompt Enhancer & History Tracker
– Works natively in Gutenberg, Elementor, Classic Editor, WooCommerce, and everywhere else

2. Seamless Image Generation
Generate high-quality images on the fly — wherever the WordPress media library exists.
– Customize scale, model, and prompt
– Automatically uploads and inserts the image
– Instant visual content, no Photoshop needed

3. Smart Chat AI Moderator
Chat with your personalized AI assistant right from your admin dashboard — and let it manage your site via secure API access.
– Write and publish posts
– Edit pages
– Moderate comments
– Execute complex multi-step commands
– All actions processed locally — your data stays with you

4. Works Everywhere in WordPress
From the content editor to the settings panel, SmartPress fits in like a native plugin — but works like a pro tool.

5. Fully Customizable
Enable or disable any feature. Control model preferences, limits, and AI behavior from the SmartPress control panel.

Who It’s For

  • Content Creators & Bloggers
  • SEO Specialists
  • Web Designers & Developers
  • Affiliate Marketers
  • Agency Teams
  • WooCommerce Store Owners
    …anyone who wants to create, automate, and scale with AI in WordPress.

Privacy Policy

SmartPress does not collect or store personal data. All AI interactions and login credentials are stored locally and securely on your own website.

Support

Join the community or reach out directly:
💬 Discord Support
📧 Email: smartpress@10g8.com

Credits

  • Developed by TenGate
  • Thanks to the WordPress open-source community

License

SmartPress is open-source software licensed under the GPL v2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smartpress folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. Access SmartPress via the WordPress Admin menu
  4. Log in or create your free SmartPress account in one click
  5. Start creating content or generate images immediately
sections.faq:
Does SmartPress work with my favorite editor or builder?

Yes. SmartPress is compatible with Gutenberg, Elementor, Classic Editor, WooCommerce, and most third-party plugins.

Is SmartPress really free?

Absolutely. You can create an account and use SmartPress with basic models for free. PRO unlocks premium models and faster usage.

Is the Smart Chat safe to use on my site?

Yes. The chatbot uses application passwords and REST API securely. All access credentials are stored locally.

Can the AI really manage my site?

Yes — the Smart Chat AI can write, post, update, and even moderate content on command. It’s like hiring a VA with an AI brain.
